study: P0 A/B source and transfer identifiability audit
status: Diagnostic protocol frozen after attached and earlier development results were exposed, before this diagnostic execution. Not an untouched-data confirmatory protocol.
scope: Reproduce descriptive raw A/B correlations by dose, authenticate source recipe and diagnose original baseline-residual transfer only. No new P1 method or outer target decision scoring.
data: Authenticated scalar45-by146 packet;43 complete A/B contexts;4/8/16 histories with seeds11/23/47 and same outerheld nested prefixes as original pairwise study.
raw_diagnostics: Within each complete context, candidate Pearson and Spearman A/B correlations on all146 and dose groups0.05,0.5,5uM; group means and A-B difference SD. Across-context correlation per candidate is descriptive only.
source_audit: Parse exact menu drug/dose/unit to source A/B plate pairs. Audit archived source bytes from Git91b0c10 against original source hashes, available original metadata, absent raw upstream inputs, control construction and sampling. Distinguish two wells from within-well hash halves.
transfer_validation: For every outerheld history, refit entire original mean/offset/crossfit residual moments within three inner context folds. Compute residual Pearson, pooled covariance-rho, fixed shared one-A pair residual prediction MSE at alpha1 and0.1 against zero prediction, and old support eligibility. Do not fit slopes on globally precomputed residuals because their priors can include inner validation labels.
query_diagnostics: From training-only old covariance and outer public M2 prior, freeze original nine pairs and boundary A. Compute its rank and relative value among146 model-implied pair variance reductions, and exact-dose pair support. No target A/B or alternative-query replay.
inference: No hypothesis-test or effect gate. Overlapping histories and inner cases are not independent samples. Original outerhold unit remains43; this audit is diagnostic rather than a scientific risk certificate.
unknowns: One A/B scalar per action cannot distinguish biological disagreement, sampling/control noise, culture batch and plate/source effect. Current precision_B is not a certified39gene measurement variance. Real exposure time and culture independence not inferred from simulation metadata.
limits: STATE pretraining overlaps references; endpoint is a39gene transcript projection rather than apoptosis or viability. Original raw inputs and2000gene coordinate asset are missing. Cached arithmetic can reproduce while raw biological reconstruction remains blocked.
amendment_boundary: Corrected-conditional-mean residual diagnostics, when their final v3 helpers are ready, require a separately frozen phase before that computation; they will not alter these original-channel outputs.
